g.text: Reconstruction anchored to the documented 2.4 m canopy span
Working interpretation: 2.4 m is the flat span; trace the inflated mid-chord arch to set scale.
Crown is not the canopy CG.
Effective span still needs line loads.
Interpretation check: if 2.4 m meant projected span, the same stock holes would be ≈222 mm apart.
The separate manual kit-photo estimate (~174–184 mm) favors the flat-span interpretation, but does not prove it.
Original photo preserved. Perspective and manual tracing remain uncertain. Source: HobbyKing V2 product photo and manual.
